reason: I'd send one café the free link and see if anyone actually shows my coupon, but I'm not paying for a pass until I know businesses here take it seriously. Most of my collabs are barter from WhatsApp group leads, and those don't need an app.
objection: Will any café owner actually bother counting coupons, or will it be empty like the other apps? And will a 'customers I brought' number from a Kannada page with 5K followers really get me cash instead of free food?
would_change_my_mind: If my first free counted collab shows real numbers, and I see a few Bengaluru brands paying creators because of their Mitra record, especially Kannada creators like me.
